scenes.stage_direction: Adrian's surviving records reopen grief. Leave a pause around Amara's response; David does not speak over it.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The copy is genuine. The family was told it no longer existed.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Somebody made the questions stop before I even knew how to ask them.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Its time conflicts with the public account of that evening.

metadata.evidence_summary: The family was falsely told no copy remained.
